title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
overview: The Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals course is designed to introduce individuals to the basic concepts of cloud services and how those concepts are implemented using Microsoft Azure. It covers fundamental cloud concepts, core Azure services, Azure pricing, and support, providing a foundation for further Azure certifications and cloud-related roles.
audience: Individuals new to cloud computing and Microsoft Azure.
IT professionals seeking to understand cloud services and Azure basics.
Business decision-makers and managers interested in cloud solutions.
Students and learners aiming to start a career in cloud computing.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Overview of cloud computing and Azure services.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to explore Azure services and management tools.
Case Studies: Real-world examples to illustrate cloud solutions and benefits.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to discuss cloud strategies and implementations.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Basic cloud concepts and Azure services
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of cloud computing and Microsoft Azure.
To develop basic skills in navigating and utilizing Azure services.
To prepare participants for the Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) certification exam.
To familiarize participants with Azure pricing, support options, and management tools.
